ImageDescription.value: Northern end of Ninety Mile Beach at the "Te Paki Sand Dunes" (New Zealand). Ninety Mile Beach is a 90 kilometer long sandy beach along the west coast in the northernmost part of New Zealand. The beach can be used at low tide from Kaitaia as an alternative to driving to Caoe Reinga at your own risk.
